title: Yousician Lesson Session Score Leaderboard
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=yousician:lesson score_pct=*
| stats sum(score_pct) as total_value, avg(score_pct) as avg_value by instrument_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks instrument name values by total and average score across Yousician lesson session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `score_pct` values for each Yousician lesson session event and review total and average score by instrument name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total score.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which instrument name shows the biggest score numbers in your Yousician lesson session data.
